unknowns: The source supplies no equipment tags, instrument tags, valve tags or control loops; no instruments, final elements or controllers are represented.
The order of the pre-reactor compressor and pre-reactor heater relative to each other is not given, so no streams are drawn between the feed mixer, compressor, heater and reactor.
The positions of the turbine and cooler relative to the reactor and Flash unit are not given; the reactor-to-Flash path (described only as post-reactor) is not drawn.

The recycle configuration sends most Flash vapor back to the 'start of the process'; the exact recycle destination unit and the purge split equipment are not given, so the recycle stream is not drawn.
Whether hydrogen and carbon monoxide enter as two separate physical feed lines is not stated explicitly.
Which configuration (no-recycle or recycle case) is the intended drawing basis is not stated.

Line sizes, materials, operating conditions, engineering units of any instrumentation, operating limits and trips are unspecified; the 10-50% purge range is an optimization bound, not an operating limit.
The source is a simulation notebook example and states it does not represent any particular chemical process.
assumptions: Symbol dimensions and locations are proposed drafting geometry, not plant dimensions.
All unit and stream identifiers are newly assigned because the source supplies none.
The turbine has no supported symbol type; it is represented with the closest supported type, compressor, keeping the name Turbine.
The feed mixing step of the pre-reactor section is represented as a feed_header unit named Feed mixer.
The liquid outlet Product block and the exhaust are represented as battery limits rather than equipment.
Streams S-H2 and S-CO (hydrogen and carbon monoxide feeds to the feed mixer) are order-based interpretations of source.txt:L10-L10 for review.
Stream S-LIQ (Flash unit liquid outlet to the Product block battery limit) is an order-based interpretation of source.txt:L58-L58 for review.
Stream S-VAP (Flash vapor to the exhaust battery limit) is an order-based interpretation of source.txt:L73-L73 for review.
